about: The same debate, but every agent may have a long input condensed by an extra call before it reads it.
how: From the second round on, each agent first sends the earlier text to a short summary call and then answers from the summary.
learns: Condensing keeps the input shorter (about 30,000 instead of 33,700 input tokens), but it adds calls and time: 18 steps and 55 seconds instead of 10 steps and 43 seconds. On a short debate the saving is small.
watch: The condense steps before the answers, and how long each summary is. Compare the totals in Statistics with the twin.
